messages:
Jenna Li: Quick heads-up — I'm assembling the release notes + changelog bullets for the next docs publish. Main items: adaptive routing GA, embedding-streaming deprecation, and a small SDK snippet rename. PRs are #5123 (changelog draft) and #5127 (snippet updates). Need a fast sweep for link health and migration steps.
Samir Patel: Thanks — I can check the migration guide and link redirects. Anything specific to flag?
Jenna Li: Two things: 1) Migration guide needs a short code diff showing old -> new call. 2) Update the 'known issues' line about routing fallbacks (latency edge-case when cache warm-up). Keep bullets concise.
Ashley Gomez: I reviewed #5127 — the python snippet still uses `client.generate()` instead of `client.responses.create()`. I can push a small patch.
Michael R.: Also watch the JS sample — it has `stream: true` which will change when streaming is removed for embeddings. Add a note: "use async polling" or link to the migration snippet.
Oliver T.: I'll run link-checker on the docs tree and patch obvious 404s. If anyone pins me the PRs I'll commit fixes directly.
Samir Patel: Pinned. I found two broken redirects under /guides/migration (old embed streaming docs) — filing quick redirects in #redirects.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs deploy window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Any last-minute changelog edits must be merged by 07:30 PT to make the cut.
Jenna Li: Good call. Ashley, can you submit your snippet patch by EOD PST? Michael — can you add the migration note to the changelog bullet? I can write the short "what changed" blurb after your note.
Ashley Gomez: Yep — pushing a small commit in a minute: replace `client.generate()` -> `client.responses.create({ input: ... })` and add a short comment about rate limiting differences.
Michael R.: Added a one-line migration bullet: "Embedding streaming deprecated — switch to polling or batch upload; see migration guide (link)." Pls review.
Jenna Li: Nice. Oliver — any major link health issues?
Oliver T.: Mostly stale anchors and two absolute http links that should be internal. I fixed anchors and opened an MR for the http->https/relative updates.
Samir Patel: I cleaned up the migration guide wording to include a snippet showing how to convert streaming client code to a polling flow. Short and concrete.
Jenna Li: Perfect. Final checklist: 1) merge #5127 (snippets) 2) merge #5123 (changelog) 3) merge redirect MR from #redirects 4) run link-checker post-merge. Anyone want to co-sign for release? :thumbsup:
Ashley Gomez: :thumbsup: 5127 merged (small patch).
Michael R.: 5123 updated with my bullet and link.
Oliver T.: Redirects MR ready for merge (pending CI).
Jenna Li: Awesome — I'll queue the changelog for publish after CI green. If anything breaks after deploy, ping #docs with "deploy-rollback" and we can revert. Thanks all! :rocket:
